v.t: Praise be to God, who revealed the Book to His servant, and allowed in it no distortion
v.l: Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi 'Anzala `Ala `Abdihi Al-Kitaba Wa Lam Yaj`al Llahu `Iwaja

v.t: Valuable—to warn of severe punishment from Himself; and to deliver good news to the believers who do righteous deeds, that they will have an excellent reward
v.l: Qayyimaan Liyundhira Ba'saan Shadidaan Min Ladunhu Wa Yubashira Al-Mu'uminina Al-Ladhina Ya`maluna As-Salihati 'Anna Lahum 'Ajraan Hasanaan

v.t: In which they will abide forever
v.l: Makithina Fihi 'Abadaan

v.t: And to warn those who say, “God has begotten a son.”
v.l: Wa Yundhira Al-Ladhina Qalu Attakhadha Allahu Waladaan

v.t: They have no knowledge of this, nor did their forefathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths. They say nothing but a lie
v.l: Mma Lahum Bihi Min `Ilmin Wa La Li'aba'ihim Kaburat Kalimatan Takhruju Min 'Afwahihim 'In Yaquluna 'Illa Kadhibaan

v.t: Perhaps you may destroy yourself with grief, chasing after them, if they do not believe in this information
v.l: Fala`allaka Bakhi`un Nafsaka `Ala 'Atharihim 'In Lam Yu'uminu Bihadha Al-Hadithi 'Asafaan

v.t: We made what is upon the earth an ornament for it, to test them as to which of them is best in conduct
v.l: Inna Ja`alna Ma `Ala Al-'Arđi Zinatan Laha Linabluwahum 'Ayyuhum 'Ahsanu `Amalaan

v.t: And We will turn what is on it into barren waste
v.l: Wa 'Inna Laja`iluna Ma `Alayha Sa`idaan Juruzaan

v.t: Did you know that the People of the Cave and the Inscription were of Our wondrous signs
v.l: Am Hasibta 'Anna 'Ashaba Al-Kahfi Wa Ar-Raqimi Kanu Min 'Ayatina `Ajabaan

v.t: When the youths took shelter in the cave, they said, “Our Lord, give us mercy from Yourself, and bless our affair with guidance.”
v.l: Idh 'Awa Al-Fityatu 'Ila Al-Kahfi Faqalu Rabbana 'Atina Min Ladunka Rahmatan Wa Hayyi' Lana Min 'Amrina Rashadaan

v.t: Then We sealed their ears in the cave for a number of years
v.l: Fađarabna `Ala 'Adhanihim Fi Al-Kahfi Sinina `Adadaan

v.t: Then We awakened them to know which of the two groups could better calculate the length of their stay
v.l: Thumma Ba`athnahum Lina`lama 'Ayyu Al-Hizbayni 'Ahsa Lima Labithu 'Amadaan

v.t: We relate to you their story in truth. They were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance
v.l: Nahnu Naqussu `Alayka Naba'ahum Bil-Haqqi 'Innahum Fityatun 'Amanu Birabbihim Wa Zidnahum Hudaan

v.t: And We strengthened their hearts, when they stood up and said, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth; we will not call on any god besides Him, for then we would have spoken an outrage.”
v.l: Wa Rabatna `Ala Qulubihim 'Idh Qamu Faqalu Rabbuna Rabbu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Lan Nad`uwa Min Dunihi 'Ilahaan Laqad Qulna 'Idhaan Shatataan

v.t: “These people, our people, have taken to themselves gods other than Him. Why do they not bring a clear proof concerning them? Who, then, does greater wrong than he who invents lies and attributes them to God?”
v.l: Ha'ula' Qawmuna Attakhadhu Min Dunihi 'Alihatan Lawla Ya'tuna `Alayhim Bisultanin Bayyinin Faman 'Azlamu Mimmani Aftara `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan

v.t: “Now that you have withdrawn from them, and from what they worship besides God, take shelter in the cave. And your Lord will unfold His mercy for you, and will set your affair towards ease.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh A`tazaltumuhum Wa Ma Ya`buduna 'Illa Allaha Fa'wu 'Ila Al-Kahfi Yanshur Lakum Rabbukum Min Rahmatihi Wa Yuhayyi' Lakum Min 'Amrikum Mirfaqaan

v.t: You would have seen the sun, when it rose, veering away from their cave towards the right, and when it sets, moving away from them to the left, as they lay in the midst of the cave. That was one of God’s wonders. He whom God guides is truly guided; but he whom He misguides, for him you will find no directing friend
v.l: Wa Tara Ash-Shamsa 'Idha Tala`at Tazawaru `An Kahfihim Dhata Al-Yamini Wa 'Idha Gharabat Taqriđuhum Dhata Ash-Shimali Wa Hum Fi Fajwatin Minhu Dhalika Min 'Ayati Allahi Man Yahdi Allahu Fahuwa Al-Muhtadi Wa Man Yuđlil Falan Tajida Lahu Waliyaan Murshidaan

v.t: You would think them awake, although they were asleep. And We turned them over to the right, and to the left, with their dog stretching its paws across the threshold. Had you looked at them, you would have turned away from them in flight, and been filled with fear of them
v.l: Wa Tahsabuhum 'Ayqazaan Wa Hum Ruqudun Wa Nuqallibuhum Dhata Al-Yamini Wa Dhata Ash-Shimali Wa Kalbuhum Basitun Dhira`ayhi Bil-Wasidi Lawi Attala`ta `Alayhim Lawallayta Minhum Firaraan Wa Lamuli'ta Minhum Ru`baan
w: and surely you would have been filled

v.t: Even so, We awakened them, so that they may ask one another. A speaker among them said, “How long have you stayed?” They said, “We have stayed a day, or part of a day.” They said, “Your Lord knows best how long you have stayed.” “Send one of you to the city, with this money of yours, and let him see which food is most suitable, and let him bring you some provision thereof. And let him be gentle, and let no one become aware of you.”
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Ba`athnahum Liyatasa'alu Baynahum Qala Qa'ilun Minhum Kam Labithtum Qalu Labithna Yawmaan 'Aw Ba`đa Yawmin Qalu Rabbukum 'A`lamu Bima Labithtum Fab`athu 'Ahadakum Biwariqikum Hadhihi 'Ila Al-Madinati Falyanzur 'Ayyuha 'Azka Ta`amaan Falya'tikum Birizqin Minhu Wa Liatalattaf Wa La Yush`iranna Bikum 'Ahadaan
w: with this silver coin of yours
with this silver coin of yours
and let him bring to you

v.t: “If they discover you, they will stone you, or force you back into their religion; then you will never be saved.”
v.l: Innahum 'In Yazharu `Alaykum Yarjumukum 'Aw Yu`idukum Fi Millatihim Wa Lan Tuflihu 'Idhaan 'Abadaan

v.t: So it was, that We caused them to be discovered, that they would know that the promise of God is true, and that of the Hour there is no doubt. As they were disputing their case among themselves, they said, “Build over them a building.” Their Lord knows best about them. Those who prevailed over their case said, “We will set up over them a place of worship.”
v.l: Wa Kadhalika 'A`tharna `Alayhim Liya`lamu 'Anna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Wa 'Anna As-Sa`ata La Rayba Fiha 'Idh Yatanaza`una Baynahum 'Amrahum Faqalu Abnu `Alayhim Bunyanaan Rabbuhum 'A`lamu Bihim Qala Al-Ladhina Ghalabu `Ala 'Amrihim Lanattakhidhanna `Alayhim Masjidaan

v.t: They will say, “Three, and their fourth being their dog.” And they will say, “Five, and their sixth being their dog,” guessing at the unknown. And they will say, “Seven, and their eighth being their dog.” Say, “My Lord knows best their number.” None knows them except a few. So do not argue concerning them except with an obvious argument, and do not consult any of them about them
v.l: Sayaquluna Thalathatun Rabi`uhum Kalbuhum Wa Yaquluna Khamsatun Sadisuhum Kalbuhum Rajmaan Bil-Ghaybi Wa Yaquluna Sab`atun Wa Thaminuhum Kalbuhum Qul Rabbi 'A`lamu Bi`iddatihim Ma Ya`lamuhum 'Illa Qalilun Fala Tumari Fihim 'Illa Mira'an Zahiraan Wa La Tastafti Fihim Minhum 'Ahadaan

v.t: And never say about anything, “I will do that tomorrow.”
v.l: Wa La Taqulanna Lishay'in 'Inni Fa`ilun Dhalika Ghadaan

v.t: Without saying, “If God wills.” And remember your Lord if you forget, and say, “Perhaps my Lord will guide me to nearer than this in integrity.”
v.l: Illa 'An Yasha'a Allahu Wa Adhkur Rabbaka 'Idha Nasita Wa Qul `Asa 'An Yahdiyani Rabbi Li'qraba Min Hadha Rashadaan

v.t: And they stayed in their cave for three hundred years, adding nine
v.l: Wa Labithu Fi Kahfihim Thalatha Mia'atin Sinina Wa Azdadu Tis`aan

v.t: Say, “God knows best how long they stayed.” His is the mystery of the heavens and the earth. By Him you see and hear. They have no guardian apart from Him, and He shares His Sovereignty with no one
v.l: Quli Allahu 'A`lamu Bima Labithu Lahu Ghaybu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Absir Bihi Wa 'Asmi` Ma Lahum Min Dunihi Min Wa Liyin Wa La Yushriku Fi Hukmihi 'Ahadaan

v.t: And recite what was revealed to you from the Book of your Lord. There is no changing His words, and you will find no refuge except in Him
v.l: Wa Atlu Ma 'Uhiya 'Ilayka Min Kitabi Rabbika La Mubaddila Likalimatihi Wa Lan Tajida Min Dunihi Multahadaan

v.t: And content yourself with those who pray to their Lord morning and evening, desiring His Presence. And do not turn your eyes away from them, desiring the glitter of this world. And do not obey him whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance—so he follows his own desires—and his priorities are confused
v.l: Wa Asbir Nafsaka Ma`a Al-Ladhina Yad`una Rabbahum Bil-Ghadaati Wa Al-`Ashiyi Yuriduna Wajhahu Wa La Ta`du `Aynaka `Anhum Turidu Zinata Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa La Tuti` Man 'Aghfalna Qalbahu `An Dhikrina Wa Attaba`a Hawahu Wa Kana 'Amruhu Furutaan

v.t: And say, “The truth is from your Lord. Whoever wills—let him believe. And whoever wills—let him disbelieve”. We have prepared for the unjust a Fire, whose curtains will hem them in. And when they cry for relief, they will be relieved with water like molten brass, which scalds the faces. What a miserable drink, and what a terrible place
v.l: Wa Quli Al-Haqqu Min Rabbikum Faman Sha'a Falyu'umin Wa Man Sha'a Falyakfur 'Inna 'A`tadna Lilzzalimina Naraan 'Ahata Bihim Suradiquha Wa 'In Yastaghithu Yughathu Bima'in Kalmuhli Yashwi Al-Wujuha Bi'sa Ash-Sharabu Wa Sa'at Murtafaqaan

v.t: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—We will not waste the reward of those who work righteousness
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati 'Inna La Nuđi`u 'Ajra Man 'Ahsana `Amalaan

v.t: These will have the Gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow. Reclining on comfortable furnishings, they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and will wear green garments of silk and brocade. What a wonderful reward, and what an excellent resting-place
v.l: Ula'ika Lahum Jannatu `Adnin Tajri Min Tahtihimu Al-'Anharu Yuhallawna Fiha Min 'Asawira Min Dhahabin Wa Yalbasuna Thiyabaan Khuđraan Min Sundusin Wa 'Istabraqin Muttaki'ina Fiha `Ala Al-'Ara'iki Ni`ma Ath-Thawabu Wa Hasunat Murtafaqaan

v.t: And cite for them the parable of two men. To one of them We gave two gardens of vine, and We surrounded them with palms-trees, and We placed between them crops
v.l: Wa Ađrib Lahum Mathalaan Rajulayni Ja`alna Li'hadihima Jannatayni Min 'A`nabin Wa Hafafnahuma Binakhlin Wa Ja`alna Baynahuma Zar`aan

v.t: Both gardens produced their harvest in full, and suffered no loss. And We made a river flow through them
v.l: Kilta Al-Jannatayni 'Atat 'Ukulaha Wa Lam Tazlim Minhu Shay'aan Wa Fajjarna Khilalahuma Naharaan
w: And We caused to gush forth

v.t: And thus he had abundant fruits. He said to his friend, as he conversed with him, “I am wealthier than you, and greater in manpower.”
v.l: Wa Kana Lahu Thamarun Faqala Lisahibihi Wa Huwa Yuhawiruhu 'Ana 'Aktharu Minka Malaan Wa 'A`azzu Nafaraan

v.t: And he entered his garden, wronging himself. He said, “I do not think this will ever perish.”
v.l: Wa Dakhala Jannatahu Wa Huwa Zalimun Linafsihi Qala Ma 'Azunnu 'An Tabida Hadhihi 'Abadaan

v.t: “And I do not think the Hour is coming. And even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find something better than this in return.”
v.l: Wa Ma 'Azunnu As-Sa`ata Qa'imatan Wa La'in Rudidtu 'Ila Rabbi La'ajidanna Khayraan Minha Munqalabaan

v.t: His friend said to him, as he conversed with him, “Are you being ungrateful to Him who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then evolved you into a man
v.l: Qala Lahu Sahibuhu Wa Huwa Yuhawiruhu 'Akafarta Bial-Ladhi Khalaqaka Min Turabin Thumma Min Nutfatin Thumma Sawwaka Rajulaan

v.t: But as for me, He is God, my Lord, and I never associate with my Lord anyone
v.l: Lakinna Huwa Allahu Rabbi Wa La 'Ushriku Birabbi 'Ahadaan

v.t: When you entered your garden, why did you not say, “As God wills; there is no power except through God”? Although you see me inferior to you in wealth and children
v.l: Wa Lawla 'Idh Dakhalta Jannataka Qulta Ma Sha'a Allahu La Quwata 'Illa Billahi 'In Tarani 'Ana 'Aqalla Minka Malaan Wa Waladaan

v.t: Perhaps my Lord will give me something better than your garden, and release upon it thunderbolts from the sky, so it becomes barren waste
v.l: Fa`asa Rabbi 'An Yu'utiyani Khayraan Min Jannatika Wa Yursila `Alayha Husbanaan Mina As-Sama'i Fatusbiha Sa`idaan Zalaqaan

v.t: Or its water will sink into the ground, and you will be unable to draw it.”
v.l: Aw Yusbiha Ma'uuha Ghawraan Falan Tastati`a Lahu Talabaan

v.t: And ruin closed in on his crops, and so he began wringing his hands over what he had invested in it, as it lays fallen upon its trellises. And he was saying, “I wish I never associated anyone with my Lord.”
v.l: Wa 'Uhita Bithamarihi Fa'asbaha Yuqallibu Kaffayhi `Ala Ma 'Anfaqa Fiha Wa Hiya Khawiyatun `Ala `Urushiha Wa Yaqulu Ya Laytani Lam 'Ushrik Birabbi 'Ahadaan

v.t: He had no faction to help him besides God, and he was helpless
v.l: Wa Lam Takun Lahu Fi'atun Yansurunahu Min Duni Allahi Wa Ma Kana Muntasiraan

v.t: That is because authority belongs to God, the True. He is Best in rewarding, and Best in requiting
v.l: Hunalika Al-Walayatu Lillahi Al-Haqqi Huwa Khayrun Thawabaan Wa Khayrun `Uqbaan

v.t: And cite for them the parable of the present life: it is like water that We send down from the sky; the plants of the earth absorb it; but then it becomes debris, scattered by the wind. God has absolute power over everything
v.l: Wa Ađrib Lahum Mathala Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Kama'in 'Anzalnahu Mina As-Sama'i Fakhtalata Bihi Nabatu Al-'Arđi Fa'asbaha Hashimaan Tadhruhu Ar-Riyahu Wa Kana Allahu `Ala Kulli Shay'in Muqtadiraan

v.t: Wealth and children are the adornments of the present life. But the things that last, the virtuous deeds, are better with your Lord for reward, and better for hope
v.l: Al-Malu Wa Al-Banuna Zinatu Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Al-Baqiyatu As-Salihatu Khayrun `Inda Rabbika Thawabaan Wa Khayrun 'Amalaan

v.t: On the Day when We set the mountains in motion; and you see the earth emerging; and We gather them together, and leave none of them behind
v.l: Wa Yawma Nusayyiru Al-Jibala Wa Tara Al-'Arđa Barizatan Wa Hasharnahum Falam Nughadir Minhum 'Ahadaan

v.t: They will be presented before your Lord in a row. “You have come to Us as We created you the first time. Although you claimed We would not set a meeting for you.”
v.l: Wa `Uriđu `Ala Rabbika Saffaan Laqad Ji'tumuna Kama Khalaqnakum 'Awwala Marratin Bal Za`amtum 'Allan Naj`ala Lakum Maw`idaan

v.t: And the book will be placed, and you will see the sinners fearful of its contents. And they will say, “Woe to us! What is with this book that leaves nothing, small or big, but it has enumerated it?” They will find everything they had done present. Your Lord does not wrong anyone
v.l: Wa Wuđi`a Al-Kitabu Fatara Al-Mujrimina Mushfiqina Mimma Fihi Wa Yaquluna Ya Waylatana Mali Hadha Al-Kitabi La Yughadiru Saghiratan Wa La Kabiratan 'Illa 'Ahsaha Wa Wajadu Ma `Amilu Hađiraan Wa La Yazlimu Rabbuka 'Ahadaan

v.t: We said to the angels, “Bow down to Adam.” So they bowed down, except for Satan. He was of the jinn, and he defied the command of his Lord. Will you take him and his offspring as lords instead of Me, when they are an enemy to you? Evil is the exchange for the wrongdoers
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qulna Lilmala'ikati Asjudu Li'dama Fasajadu 'Illa 'Iblisa Kana Mina Al-Jinni Fafasaqa `An 'Amri Rabbihi 'Afatattakhidhunahu Wa Dhurriyatahu 'Awliya'a Min Duni Wa Hum Lakum `Aduwun Bi'sa Lilzzalimina Badalaan

v.t: I did not call them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; and I do not take the misleaders for assistants
v.l: Ma 'Ash/hadtuhum Khalqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa La Khalqa 'Anfusihim Wa Ma Kuntu Muttakhidha Al-Muđillina `Ađudaan

v.t: On the Day when He will say, “Call on My partners whom you have claimed.” They will call on them, but they will not answer them. And We will place between them a barrier
v.l: Wa Yawma Yaqulu Nadu Shuraka'iya Al-Ladhina Za`amtum Fada`awhum Falam Yastajibu Lahum Wa Ja`alna Baynahum Mawbiqaan

v.t: And the sinners will see the Fire, and will realize that they will tumble into it. They will find no deliverance from it
v.l: Wa Ra'a Al-Mujrimuna An-Nara Fazannu 'Annahum Muwaqi`uha Wa Lam Yajidu `Anha Masrifaan

v.t: We have elaborated in this Quran for the people every kind of example, but the human being is a most argumentative being
v.l: Wa Laqad Sarrafna Fi Hadha Al-Qur'ani Lilnnasi Min Kulli Mathalin Wa Kana Al-'Insanu 'Akthara Shay'in Jadalaan

v.t: What prevented people from accepting faith, when guidance has come to them, and from seeking their Lord’s forgiveness? Unless they are waiting for the precedent of the ancients to befall them, or to have the punishment come upon them face to face
v.l: Wa Ma Mana`a An-Nasa 'An Yu'uminu 'Idh Ja'ahumu Al-Huda Wa Yastaghfiru Rabbahum 'Illa 'An Ta'tiyahum Sunnatu Al-'Awwalina 'Aw Ya'tiyahumu Al-`Adhabu Qubulaan

v.t: We send the messengers only as deliverers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve argue with false argument, in order to defeat the truth thereby. They take My Verses, and the warnings, for a joke
v.l: Wa Ma Nursilu Al-Mursalina 'Illa Mubashirina Wa Mundhirina Wa Yujadilu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Bil-Batili Liyudhiđu Bihi Al-Haqqa Wa Attakhadhu 'Ayati Wa Ma 'Undhiru Huzuan

v.t: Who does greater wrong than he, who, when reminded of his Lord’s revelations, turns away from them, and forgets what his hands have put forward? We have placed coverings over their hearts, lest they understand it, and heaviness in their ears. And if you call them to guidance, they will not be guided, ever
v.l: Wa Man 'Azlamu Mimman Dhukkira Bi'ayati Rabbihi Fa'a`rađa `Anha Wa Nasiya Ma Qaddamat Yadahu 'Inna Ja`alna `Ala Qulubihim 'Akinnatan 'An Yafqahuhu Wa Fi 'Adhanihim Waqraan Wa 'In Tad`uhum 'Ila Al-Huda Falan Yahtadu 'Idhaan 'Abadaan

v.t: Your Lord is the Forgiver, Possessor of Mercy. Were He to call them to account for what they have earned, He would have hastened the punishment for them. But they have an appointment from which they will find no escape
v.l: Wa Rabbuka Al-Ghafuru Dhu Ar-Rahmati Law Yu'uakhidhuhum Bima Kasabu La`ajjala Lahumu Al-`Adhaba Bal Lahum Maw`idun Lan Yajidu Min Dunihi Maw'ilaan

v.t: And these towns—We destroyed them when they committed injustices, and We set for their destruction an appointed time
v.l: Wa Tilka Al-Qura 'Ahlaknahum Lamma Zalamu Wa Ja`alna Limahlikihim Maw`idaan

v.t: Recall when Moses said to his servant, “I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two rivers, even if it takes me years.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala Musa Lifatahu La 'Abrahu Hatta 'Ablugha Majma`a Al-Bahrayni 'Aw 'Amđiya Huqubaan

v.t: Then, when they reached the junction between them, they forgot about their fish. It found its way into the river, slipping away
v.l: Falamma Balagha Majma`a Baynihima Nasiya Hutahuma Fa Attakhadha Sabilahu Fi Al-Bahri Sarabaan

v.t: When they went further, he said to his servant, “Bring us our lunch; we were exposed in our travel to much fatigue.”
v.l: Falamma Jawaza Qala Lifatahu 'Atina Ghada'ana Laqad Laqina Min Safarina Hadha Nasabaan

v.t: He said, “Do you remember when we rested by the rock? I forgot about the fish. It was only the devil who made me forget it. And so it found its way to the river, amazingly.”
v.l: Qala 'Ara'ayta 'Idh 'Awayna 'Ila As-Sakhrati Fa'inni Nasitu Al-Huta Wa Ma 'Ansanihu 'Illa Ash-Shaytanu 'An 'Adhkurahu Wa Attakhadha Sabilahu Fi Al-Bahri `Ajabaan

v.t: He said, “This is what we were seeking.” And so they turned back retracing their steps
v.l: Qala Dhalika Ma Kunna Nabghi Fartadda `Ala 'Atharihima Qasasaan

v.t: Then they came upon a servant of Ours, whom We had blessed with mercy from Us, and had taught him knowledge from Our Own
v.l: Fawajada `Abdaan Min `Ibadina 'Ataynahu Rahmatan Min `Indina Wa `Allamnahu Min Ladunna `Ilmaan

v.t: Moses said to him, “May I follow you, so that you may teach me some of the guidance you were taught?”
v.l: Qala Lahu Musa Hal 'Attabi`uka `Ala 'An Tu`allimani Mimma `Ullimta Rushdaan

v.t: He said, “You will not be able to endure with me
v.l: Qala 'Innaka Lan Tastati`a Ma`iya Sabraan

v.t: And how will you endure what you have no knowledge of?”
v.l: Wa Kayfa Tasbiru `Ala Ma Lam Tuhit Bihi Khubraan

v.t: He said, “You will find me, God willing, patient; and I will not disobey you in any order of yours.”
v.l: Qala Satajiduni 'In Sha'a Allahu Sabiraan Wa La 'A`si Laka 'Amraan

v.t: He said, “If you follow me, do not ask me about anything, until I myself make mention of it to you.”
v.l: Qala Fa'ini Attaba`tani Fala Tas'alni `An Shay'in Hatta 'Uhditha Laka Minhu Dhikraan

v.t: So they set out. Until, when they had boarded the boat, he holed it. He said, “Did you hole it, to drown its passengers? You have done something awful.”
v.l: Fantalaqa Hatta 'Idha Rakiba Fi As-Safinati Kharaqaha Qala 'Akharaqtaha Litughriqa 'Ahlaha Laqad Ji'ta Shay'aan 'Imraan
w: he made a hole in it
Have you made a hole in it

v.t: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will not be able to endure with me?”
v.l: Qala 'Alam 'Aqul 'Innaka Lan Tastati`a Ma`iya Sabraan

v.t: He said, “Do not rebuke me for forgetting, and do not make my course difficult for me.”
v.l: Qala La Tu'uakhidhni Bima Nasitu Wa La Turhiqni Min 'Amri `Usraan

v.t: Then they set out. Until, when they encountered a boy, he killed him. He said, “Did you kill a pure soul, who killed no one? You have done something terrible.”
v.l: Fantalaqa Hatta 'Idha Laqiya Ghulamaan Faqatalahu Qala 'Aqatalta Nafsaan Zakiyatan Bighayri Nafsin Laqad Ji'ta Shay'aan Nukraan

v.t: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will not be able to endure with me?”
v.l: Qala 'Alam 'Aqul Laka 'Innaka Lan Tastati`a Ma`iya Sabraan

v.t: He said, “If I ask you about anything after this, then do not keep company with me. You have received excuses from me.”
v.l: Qala 'In Sa'altuka `An Shay'in Ba`daha Fala Tusahibni Qad Balaghta Min Ladunni `Udhraan

v.t: So they set out. Until, when they reached the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. There they found a wall about to collapse, and he repaired it. He said, “If you wanted, you could have obtained a payment for it.”
v.l: Fantalaqa Hatta 'Idha 'Ataya 'Ahla Qaryatin Astat`ama 'Ahlaha Fa'abaw 'An Yuđayyifuhuma Fawajada Fiha Jidaraan Yuridu 'An Yanqađđa Fa'aqamahu Qala Law Shi'ta Lattakhadhta `Alayhi 'Ajraan

v.t: He said, “This is the parting between you and me. I will tell you the interpretation of what you were unable to endure
v.l: Qala Hadha Firaqu Bayni Wa Baynika Sa'unabbi'uka Bita'wili Ma Lam Tastati` `Alayhi Sabraan

v.t: As for the boat, it belonged to paupers working at sea. I wanted to damage it because there was a king coming after them seizing every boat by force
v.l: Amma As-Safinatu Fakanat Limasakina Ya`maluna Fi Al-Bahri Fa'aradtu 'An 'A`ibaha Wa Kana Wara'ahum Malikun Ya'khudhu Kulla Safinatin Ghasbaan

v.t: As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared he would overwhelm them with oppression and disbelief
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Ghulamu Fakana 'Abawahu Mu'uminayni Fakhashina 'An Yurhiqahuma Tughyanaan Wa Kufraan

v.t: So we wanted their Lord to replace him with someone better in purity, and closer to mercy
v.l: Fa'aradna 'An Yubdilahuma Rabbuhuma Khayraan Minhu Zakaatan Wa 'Aqraba Ruhmaan

v.t: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphaned boys in the town. Beneath it was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man. Your Lord wanted them to reach their maturity, and then extract their treasure—as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do it of my own accord. This is the interpretation of what you were unable to endure.”
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Jidaru Fakana Lighulamayni Yatimayni Fi Al-Madinati Wa Kana Tahtahu Kanzun Lahuma Wa Kana 'Abuhuma Salihaan Fa'arada Rabbuka 'An Yablugha 'Ashuddahuma Wa Yastakhrija Kanzahuma Rahmatan Min Rabbika Wa Ma Fa`altuhu `An 'Amri Dhalika Ta'wilu Ma Lam Tasti` `Alayhi Sabraan

v.t: And they ask you about Zul-Qarnain. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”
v.l: Wa Yas'alunaka `An Dhi Al-Qarnayni Qul Sa'atlu `Alaykum Minhu Dhikraan

v.t: We established him on earth, and gave him all kinds of means
v.l: Inna Makkanna Lahu Fi Al-'Arđi Wa 'Ataynahu Min Kulli Shay'in Sababaan

v.t: He pursued a certain course
v.l: Fa'atba`a Sababaan

v.t: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it setting in a murky spring, and found a people in its vicinity. We said, “O Zul-Qarnain, you may either inflict a penalty, or else treat them kindly.”
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Balagha Maghriba Ash-Shamsi Wajadaha Taghrubu Fi `Aynin Hami'atin Wa Wajada `Indaha Qawmaan Qulna Ya Dha Al-Qarnayni 'Imma 'An Tu`adhiba Wa 'Imma 'An Tattakhidha Fihim Husnaan

v.t: He said, “As for him who does wrong, we will penalize him, then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with an unheard-of torment
v.l: Qala 'Amma Man Zalama Fasawfa Nu`adhibuhu Thumma Yuraddu 'Ila Rabbihi Fayu`adhibuhu `Adhabaan Nukraan

v.t: “But as for him who believes and acts righteously, he will have the finest reward, and We will speak to him of Our command with ease.”
v.l: Wa 'Amma Man 'Amana Wa `Amila Salihaan Falahu Jaza'an Al-Husna Wa Sanaqulu Lahu Min 'Amrina Yusraan

v.t: Then he pursued a course
v.l: Thumma 'Atba`a Sababaan

v.t: Until, when he reached the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Balagha Matli`a Ash-Shamsi Wajadaha Tatlu`u `Ala Qawmin Lam Naj`al Lahum Min Duniha Sitraan

v.t: And so it was. We had full knowledge of what he had
v.l: Kadhalika Wa Qad 'Ahatna Bima Ladayhi Khubraan

v.t: Then he pursued a course
v.l: Thumma 'Atba`a Sababaan

v.t: Until, when he reached the point separating the two barriers, he found beside them a people who could barely understand what is said
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Balagha Bayna As-Saddayni Wajada Min Dunihima Qawmaan La Yakaduna Yafqahuna Qawlaan

v.t: They said, “O Zul-Qarnain, the Gog and Magog are spreading chaos in the land. Can we pay you, to build between us and them a wall?”
v.l: Qalu Ya Dha Al-Qarnayni 'Inna Ya'juja Wa Ma'juja Mufsiduna Fi Al-'Arđi Fahal Naj`alu Laka Kharjaan `Ala 'An Taj`ala Baynana Wa Baynahum Saddaan

v.t: He said, “What my Lord has empowered me with is better. But assist me with strength, and I will build between you and them a dam.”
v.l: Qala Ma Makkanni Fihi Rabbi Khayrun Fa'a`inuni Biquwatin 'Aj`al Baynakum Wa Baynahum Radmaan

v.t: “Bring me blocks of iron.” So that, when he had leveled up between the two cliffs, he said, “Blow.” And having turned it into a fire, he said, “Bring me tar to pour over it.”
v.l: Atuni Zubara Al-Hadidi Hatta 'Idha Sawa Bayna As-Sadafayni Qala Anfukhu Hatta 'Idha Ja`alahu Naraan Qala 'Atuni 'Ufrigh `Alayhi Qitraan

v.t: So they were unable to climb it, and they could not penetrate it
v.l: Fama Asta`u 'An Yazharuhu Wa Ma Astata`u Lahu Naqbaan

v.t: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes true, He will turn it into rubble, and the promise of my Lord is always true.”
v.l: Qala Hadha Rahmatun Min Rabbi Fa'idha Ja'a Wa`du Rabbi Ja`alahu Dakka'a Wa Kana Wa`du Rabbi Haqqaan

v.t: On that Day, We will leave them surging upon one another. And the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather them together
v.l: Wa Tarakna Ba`đahum Yawma'idhin Yamuju Fi Ba`đin Wa Nufikha Fi As-Suri Fajama`nahum Jam`aan

v.t: On that Day, We will present the disbelievers to Hell, all displayed
v.l: Wa `Arađna Jahannama Yawma'idhin Lilkafirina `Arđaan

v.t: Those whose eyes were screened to My message, and were unable to hear
v.l: Al-Ladhina Kanat 'A`yunuhum Fi Ghita'in `An Dhikri Wa Kanu La Yastati`una Sam`aan

v.t: Do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants for masters instead of Me? We have prepared Hell for the hospitality of the faithless
v.l: Afahasiba Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'An Yattakhidhu `Ibadi Min Duni 'Awliya'a 'Inna 'A`tadna Jahannama Lilkafirina Nuzulaan

v.t: Say, “Shall We inform you of the greatest losers in their works?”
v.l: Qul Hal Nunabbi'ukum Bil-'Akhsarina 'A`malaan

v.t: “Those whose efforts in this world are misguided, while they assume that they are doing well.”
v.l: Al-Ladhina Đalla Sa`yuhum Fi Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Hum Yahsabuna 'Annahum Yuhsinuna Sun`aan

v.t: It is they who rejected the communications of their Lord, and the encounter with Him. So their works are in vain. And on the Day of Resurrection, We will consider them of no weight
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Kafaru Bi'ayati Rabbihim Wa Liqa'ihi Fahabitat 'A`maluhum Fala Nuqimu Lahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Waznaan

v.t: That is their requital—Hell—on account of their disbelief, and their taking My revelations and My messengers in mockery
v.l: Dhalika Jaza'uuhum Jahannamu Bima Kafaru Wa Attakhadhu 'Ayati Wa Rusuli Huzuan

v.t: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have the Gardens of Paradise for hospitality
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Kanat Lahum Jannatu Al-Firdawsi Nuzulaan

v.t: Abiding therein forever, without desiring any change therefrom
v.l: Khalidina Fiha La Yabghuna `Anha Hiwalaan

v.t: Say, “If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would run out, before the words of my Lord run out,” even if We were to bring the like of it in addition to it
v.l: Qul Law Kana Al-Bahru Midadaan Likalimati Rabbi Lanafida Al-Bahru Qabla 'An Tanfada Kalimatu Rabbi Wa Law Ji'na Bimithlihi Madadaan

v.t: Say, “I am only a human being like you, being inspired that your god is One God. Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and never associate anyone with the service of his Lord.”
v.l: Qul 'Innama 'Ana Basharun Mithlukum Yuha 'Ilayya 'Annama 'Ilahukum 'Ilahun Wahidun Faman Kana Yarju Liqa'a Rabbihi Falya`mal `Amalaan Salihaan Wa La Yushrik Bi`ibadati Rabbihi 'Ahadaan
